requirements.source: BOOK☆WALKER をクロール対象に追加して欲しい

criteria.description: bookwalker is registered as a concrete source adapter and registration remains complete for every concrete adapter module.
bookwalker series/list URLs and book detail URLs normalize to stable work descriptors with canonical seed URLs and source-specific metadata.
bookwalker latest crawling extracts the latest book UUID, canonical public URL, readable title, series title, update label, and main_story classification from supported page shapes.
bookwalker has a normal fixture bundle and a source drift canary contract that is covered with the rest of the registered sources.
bookwalker is exposed through search registration and parses BOOK☆WALKER search results into canonical series seed URLs.
bookwalker URLs accepted by the source capability surface can be added to the watchlist with normalized IDs, seed URLs, and source values.

assumptions: BOOK☆WALKER crawling support means integrating the source with the existing adapter, search, drift canary, Discord registration, and watchlist registration surfaces rather than adding a new command surface.
The representative BOOK☆WALKER search query is allowed to remain in the opt-in live E2E matrix because the repository already gates real network search tests behind RUN_REAL_SEARCH_E2E=1.
